verdict.rationale: Sill is a local Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and control tool with no account or server, and the evidence documents no sandbox environment separate from the user's real Mac. The closest item is the developer `--synthetic` flag on the command-line host, which streams a test pattern instead of the real screen. That is a developer test fixture for the stream, not a sandbox where interactions can be tested without touching the user's real Mac and data, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: With `--synthetic` it streams a test pattern with no Screen Recording needed.
